visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young woman standing against a gradient background of light blue and soft pink. She has long, dark hair and wears a lavender-colored halter-style top. In her left hand, she holds a black and ivory-colored alto recorder, while her right hand waves at the camera. She smiles brightly, appearing cheerful and inviting. To her left is an album art graphic labeled 'SODA POP' and to her right is another graphic that says 'MY LITTLE SODA POP'. (2) The woman brings the alto recorder to her lips and begins to play. Her fingers move rhythmically over the instrument's holes. As she plays, musical notation—specifically numbers, letters, and phonetic symbols—appears at the bottom of the screen to guide the viewer. A red line moves across a musical staff at the top of the frame, indicating the current note. Small inset video clips appear on the right side, showing several young girls dancing in a colorful studio environment, synchronized with the tempo of the music.
